title: State of Frontier Systems Edition
summary: Assemble a flagship synthesis, seventeen executive topic summaries, six regional orientations, and twelve bounded cross-system comparisons as a thirty-six-record reference edition.
publication_boundaries: This is an append-only synthesis over existing repository records; it does not rewrite an upstream source, signal, project, place, mission, or validation receipt.
A mapped authority rail, candidate artifact, prepared case, or longitudinal passport does not establish implementation, acceptance, recurring operation, outcome, causation, score, or rank.
No future-dated evidence check, owner disposition, publication decision, Git operation, hosted deployment, public launch, or v1 promotion is inferred.
Repository-bounded absence identifies what the inspected corpus has not established; it is never a claim that qualifying evidence does not exist elsewhere.

edition_records.title: State of Frontier Systems 2026: reference edition
edition_records.current_read: The repository now supports a seventeen-topic reference spine, a governed project/place conversion layer, international authority orientations, an explicit evidence backlog, and a zero-presumption outcomes observatory. Its strongest contribution is not a universal verdict: it is the ability to distinguish commitment, authority, implementation, acceptance, repeated operation, and measured outcome without collapsing them.
edition_records.decision_use: Start with the cross-system conversion boundary, then move to a topic, named case, place system, exact source, and open evidence mission.
edition_records.boundary: A mapped authority rail, candidate artifact, prepared case, or longitudinal passport does not establish implementation, acceptance, recurring operation, outcome, causation, score, or rank.

edition_records.title: Advanced Manufacturing: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The Published shelf shows advanced manufacturing as a coupled production system rather than a collection of factory announcements. Drive48 reports an operating training facility and more than 2,000 graduates; Monaghan Medical's certified project record pairs completed investment with a current employment count; the F-15EX record fixes delivery to a named receiving wing; and the KC-46 plan separates three availability workstreams. Together they show that facilities, workforce, delivered assets and operational readiness are related but non-interchangeable forms of evidence. The central editorial conclusion is therefore procedural: capacity should be traced through facility readiness, workforce preparation, process qualification, accepted output and performance in the receiving system. A completed building or funded expansion can remove a constraint without proving stable yield, dependable throughput or mission availability.
edition_records.decision_use: Test whether an announcement, factory milestone, or delivery establishes dependable accepted production—and identify the missing bridge when it does not.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Agriculture and Bioeconomy: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The agriculture shelf contains four distinct forms of evidence: crop-market outlook revisions, plant-trait assessment rules, a named set of breeding awards and funded production-and-resilience research. Those records clarify expectations, authorization conditions and research direction. None by itself establishes that a trait is commercially available, adopted by producers or improving yields and resilience under field conditions. A useful public account must follow a trait or practice through research, assessment, multiplication, distribution, adoption and seasonally comparable results. The geographic and climatic context matters because performance cannot be transferred from a funded research objective to a farm, crop or region without a matching field record.
edition_records.decision_use: Separate biological potential and funded demonstrations from repeatable farm, processing, ecological, and household outcomes.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: AI for Science: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The current shelf connects federal research priorities, a national AI research-resource pilot, a completed NIST ARIA evaluation pilot and a metrology method-selection layer. This establishes public direction, access infrastructure and concrete evaluation practice. It does not establish that AI-generated findings have been independently reproduced, incorporated into scientific workflows or translated into durable research outcomes. The chapter therefore treats compute access, data access, evaluation design and scientific validation as separate dependencies. A larger inventory of AI uses or a completed pilot can describe activity and evaluation capability; neither substitutes for task-level performance, external replication, monitoring in use or evidence that research decisions improved.
edition_records.decision_use: Distinguish access to AI infrastructure from accepted scientific use, reproducible workflow improvement, and downstream discovery impact.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Aviation: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The aviation shelf separates a final powered-lift operating rule, eight federal integration-pilot selections, DARPA's measured Lift Challenge result and annual carrier-service reporting. These records span permission, planned integration, experimental performance and established service measurement. Their value comes from not collapsing them into a single claim that advanced aircraft service has arrived. The measured Lift Challenge result closes one competition gate, including named ratios and awards, while leaving maturation, manufacture, certification and deployment open. Likewise, the powered-lift rule supplies an operating framework but not a certified aircraft, approved operator, usable vertiport network or repeated passenger service.
edition_records.decision_use: Join aircraft, airport, route, fleet, exposure, and reporting-period identities before making a readiness or outcome claim.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Chips and Compute: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The shelf anchors compute expansion in two receiving systems. In Phoenix, a planning envelope, fab construction milestone, apprenticeship pipeline and wastewater agreement expose the dependencies around a named semiconductor campus. In Northern Virginia, load concentration, a new very-large-load rate class and generator-permit controls show how compute demand meets utility planning, cost allocation and local environmental authority. These records demonstrate why headline investment is an incomplete denominator. A topped-out facility is not commissioned output; a service-territory statement is not customer capacity; a tariff is not energized load; and a wastewater agreement is not measured reuse. The chapter follows each dependency to the record that would prove actual conversion.
edition_records.decision_use: Track the full chain from subsidy and construction through utilities, qualification, customer acceptance, recurring output, and local effects.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Climate: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The climate shelf connects a dated NOAA ENSO discussion, the Fifth National Climate Assessment's transportation-risk synthesis and an EPA infrastructure-funding review denominator. A Kennedy Space Center record adds one completed prescribed-burn event coordinated during an active launch countdown. Together these establish observed or assessed conditions, lifecycle risk, administrative state and a bounded local operating adaptation; they do not automatically establish reduced loss or durable resilience. The necessary translation is geographic and institutional. A climate condition becomes decision evidence only after it is connected to a named place, asset or population; an accountable authority; an exposure and vulnerability baseline; an adopted response; delivered work; and an outcome measured over a defined event or period. The Kennedy event demonstrates feasibility in one context, not a repeated program or quantified resilience benefit.
edition_records.decision_use: Keep observation, attribution, projection, exposure, adaptation, and realized-loss evidence in separate but connected lanes.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Critical Minerals: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The critical-minerals shelf spans national production and import-reliance data, federal project selections, named Nevada land and water decisions, a financial close, air-permit compliance and reclamation assurance. It therefore makes a long conversion chain visible: strategic concern, resource and project identity, authority, finance, construction, processing, qualification and customer use. No upstream artifact can stand in for the last stages. A mineral occurrence is not a reserve; a federal land decision is not construction; a loan closing is not production; and production is not necessarily qualified material accepted into a named industrial process. Environmental compliance and closure liabilities remain part of the operating case rather than external footnotes.
edition_records.decision_use: Separate resource, reserve, authorization, finance, construction, commissioning, qualification, shipment, and recurring supply.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Cybersecurity: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The cybersecurity shelf joins recurring federal asset-visibility obligations, monitoring-data quality limits, hospital control tests, open NASA recommendations and post-quantum interoperability work. This makes cybersecurity observable as an institutional operating discipline rather than a collection of policy declarations or technical specifications. The evidence also resists a common shortcut: compliance activity is not automatically reduced risk. An agency can inventory assets incompletely, close some recommendations while others remain open, or test one institution effectively without establishing sector-wide performance. The unit of claim must stay attached to the assessed system, period, control set and reviewer.
edition_records.decision_use: Avoid rewarding under-reporting by pairing incident counts with exposure, detection, reporting, loss, recovery, and mission denominators.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Discovery Technologies: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The Published shelf joins four concrete discovery infrastructures. NSF's integrated data-systems awards fund the layer between datasets and AI-enabled research; NISAR's public radar products move a named Earth-observation mission from promise to accessible data; NIST METIS exposes initial semiconductor-metrology datasets; and a funded AI-Materials Institute defines an institutional attempt to connect models, multimodal data and experiments. These records establish awards, access surfaces and a bounded beta—not validated discovery impact. The records do not complete the impact chain. Data availability says nothing by itself about calibration quality for a particular use, independent validation of derived models, delivery of the proposed materials portal, adoption by a public or scientific institution, or a changed decision. The chapter makes those downstream questions explicit and keeps each observation, metrology and materials system separate.
edition_records.decision_use: Test whether a platform changes discovery rate, evidence quality, replication, access, or cost under a stable workflow comparison.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Energy: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The energy shelf contains unusually rich asset-level battery records. Manatee has a stable nameplate panel and a named monthly operating record; Hornsdale combines capacity, service-setting limits, enforcement and later event response; Dalrymple exposes multi-service operation and state-of-charge constraints; Gateway and Moss Landing show how thermal events, audits and corrective actions complicate capacity-only readings. This evidence demonstrates that megawatts are an identity and capability measure, not an outcome. Useful claims require duration, availability, dispatch context, state of charge, service definition, constraint and safety records. Even a documented response event remains one observation unless it joins a stable repeated series.
edition_records.decision_use: Move from installed capacity to accepted interconnection, dispatch, availability, reliability, cost, and system outcome.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Finance and Risk: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The finance shelf connects construction intentions, a Toronto housing pipeline, a preliminary capital-project pipeline, a federal loan closing and a special utility rate class for very large loads. Each record changes the conditions under which projects may proceed, yet none can be read as a completed asset or outcome. Finance is therefore both an enabling layer and a risk-allocation system. A closed loan identifies capital and obligations; a tariff identifies who may bear service costs and risks; an approved or proposed pipeline identifies intended activity. The next records are executed procurement, actual expenditure, construction progress, acceptance, service and liabilities that remain after delivery.
edition_records.decision_use: Separate capital commitment from draw, expenditure, asset delivery, operating cash flow, risk transfer, and realized public value.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Human Futures: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The Human Futures shelf grounds abstract social impact in named administrative and place records. Toronto's 24 254930 application clears a council gate while enactment conditions remain. Phoenix and Maricopa workforce baselines describe wages and covered employment without proving fab readiness. HHS and VA recommendation files show how public institutions can carry named implementation work over time. These records support a receiving-system interpretation: technical capacity becomes socially meaningful through housing, labor access, services, affordability, institutional capability and legitimate authority. A regional growth projection or project announcement cannot reveal who can participate, who bears cost, whether services remain available or whether a public institution can deliver its assigned work.
edition_records.decision_use: Make distribution, agency, care, rights, culture, intergenerational effects, and uncertainty visible beside technical capability.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Mobility: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The mobility shelf reaches two unusually concrete forms of service evidence. California has effective authority for expanded fared Waymo driverless service and a later named recall that bounds a weather-handling constraint. Amtrak records station projects turned over for passenger use, final completions, accessibility backlogs and incompatible passenger-information deployment inventories. Together these cases show why a mobility claim must keep operator, geography, asset and user state attached. Regulatory authority is not a trip count; passenger use is not necessarily final closeout; an inventory total can change because its cohort or method changed; and a recall is a bounded safety intervention rather than a general verdict on all automated service.
edition_records.decision_use: Join operator, service, route, fleet, geography, passenger, exposure, reliability, accessibility, and cost definitions before comparing outcomes.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Policy and Standards: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The shelf spans FAA operator transition, GSA post-quantum procurement paths and agency recommendation portfolios in which some actions are closed while others remain open. These records show policy as an executable sequence: a responsible authority adopts a requirement, covered entities identify scope, implementation work is assigned, evidence is tested and a reviewer records disposition. A publication date is therefore not an adoption outcome. Standards can remain drafts, final texts can await implementation profiles, and a closed recommendation can address one named action while adjacent weaknesses persist. The chapter treats revision, exceptions, conformance and retirement of legacy practice as first-class records.
edition_records.decision_use: Trace the path from proposal and adoption through effective date, procurement, implementation, testing, acceptance, enforcement, and retirement.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Quantum: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The quantum shelf is deliberately centered on post-quantum cryptography. It separates final 2024 standards, NIST's 2025 selection of HQC as a backup algorithm, preliminary PIV credential specifications and federal migration plans with dated transitions. This gives the topic an implementation spine rather than relying on generalized quantum-computing expectations. The resulting question is not whether an algorithm has been selected, but whether organizations know which systems and dependencies are exposed, acquire interoperable implementations, validate them, complete cutover and retire vulnerable legacy components. A backup-algorithm selection is not yet a standard, and a working draft is not a deployed credential system.
edition_records.decision_use: Keep physical metrics, benchmark tasks, error assumptions, accepted use, operational value, and future scenarios explicitly separate.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Space: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The space shelf connects NASA's Moon to Mars architecture, two final environmental decisions, a multi-user Kennedy master plan, an operational causeway bridge, a current Launch Complex 46 site licence and a rising annual count of FAA-licensed operations. The evidence therefore spans system design, place planning, authority, infrastructure and aggregate activity. Those stages must remain separate. A system architecture is not integrated mission hardware; an environmental decision is not a construction or launch authorization; a site licence is not an operator or mission licence; and an aggregate operation count does not identify utilization, reliability or economic benefit at a particular facility.
edition_records.decision_use: Separate environmental review, site authority, vehicle authority, mission, payload delivery, recurring service, reliability, cost, and local outcome.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.

edition_records.title: Water: executive state summary
edition_records.current_read: The water shelf distinguishes an operating reclaimed-water system in Chandler, Phoenix groundwater-management requirements, a preliminary wastewater capital program, a project-specific TSMC agreement and Toronto Water's long-horizon capital constraints. It pairs system operation with governance and future capacity rather than converting all water references into a single availability claim. Chandler's reported operating scale is a real municipal comparator, but it cannot be attributed to TSMC's project-specific reuse. Conversely, a named agreement and planned treatment facility define dependencies and milestones without proving delivered volume. Water-security claims require provider, source, treatment, quality, customer, period and competing-use denominators.
edition_records.decision_use: Connect allocation, agreement, finance, construction, acceptance, metering, quality, reuse, compliance, affordability, and ecosystem outcome.
edition_records.boundary: Edition 2 composes existing authored accounts and exact IDs. It changes no source fact, evidence status, project or place stage, comparison verdict, outcome, or owner decision.
